releases.notes:
Summary:
---
* Made customModList Config cleaner by having two fields instead of one per mod row.
* Fixed a bug inside YACL's code via mixin which lead to one not being able to type into a list entry field after the row in which it is in was already focused.

Detailed Changelog:
---
* feat: Custom Mod List entries now have separate ID and version fields in the config screen.
* fix: One was unable to type into a list entry field after clicking a row that is already focused.

releases.notes:
Summary:
---
* Added new boolean config to allow users to force an empty packet to be sent instead of no at all. (Changed defaults).
* Added new boolean config to enable/disable mod logs.
* Updated README.md to accommodate new functionality.

Detailed Changelog:
---
* Updated to appropriate version number
* Updated README.md

* feat: added sendEmptyModList boolean config to force an empty packet to be sent to the server IF the sendMostList property is true. (default true)
* feat: changed default of sendModList config to true (now the server receives and empty packet instead of none per default)
* feat: added enableModLogs boolean config for Client/Server Side Logs (default true )
